workspaces.name: Northwind CRM
workspaces.description: A CRM for small sales teams that want a clear pipeline without the admin overhead.

workspaces.name: Lumen Notes
workspaces.description: A calm notes app for people who think in Markdown.

workspaces.name: Harbor Analytics
workspaces.description: Product analytics for maritime logistics teams.

feedback.title: Scheduled weekly pipeline report
feedback.description: Let managers schedule a pipeline summary that lands in their inbox every Monday morning.

feedback.title: Salesforce two-way sync
feedback.description: We keep contacts in both systems. A two-way sync would remove the manual imports we do every week.

feedback.title: Native iOS app
feedback.description: Reps need to log calls from the road. The mobile web experience is slow on cellular networks.

feedback.title: Bulk edit deal owners
feedback.description: Reassigning twenty deals one by one is painful when someone leaves the team.

feedback.title: Dashboard loads slowly with 50k contacts
feedback.description: The home dashboard takes close to eight seconds to render for our largest account.

feedback.title: Slack notifications for won deals
feedback.description: Post a message to a Slack channel when a deal moves to Closed Won.

feedback.title: Dark mode
feedback.description: Late-night pipeline reviews would be easier on the eyes with a dark theme.

feedback.title: Email the pipeline report on a schedule
feedback.description: I want the pipeline report emailed automatically every week.

feedback.title: Custom fields on contacts
feedback.description: We track contract renewal dates and need a place to store them on the contact record.

feedback.title: Mobile push reminders for follow-ups
feedback.description: Send a push notification when a follow-up task is due.

feedback.title: Duplicate contact detection
feedback.description: Warn me when I create a contact whose email already exists.

feedback.title: Export reports to PDF
feedback.description: Executives ask for a PDF version of the quarterly forecast report.

feedback.title: Public API rate limits are too strict
feedback.description: Our nightly sync hits the rate limit after about 30 minutes.

feedback.title: iPhone app please
feedback.description: Is there any plan to build an iPhone app? I would use it every day.

feedback.title: Offline mode for mobile
feedback.description: I lose access to my notes on flights. Please cache notebooks for offline use.

feedback.title: Markdown tables
feedback.description: Support pipe tables with a visual editor for rows and columns.

feedback.title: Share notebooks with read-only links
feedback.description: Let me send a link to a notebook that others can read but not edit.

feedback.title: Import from Evernote
feedback.description: Moving my 2,000 notes from Evernote by hand is not realistic.

feedback.title: Sync conflicts overwrite my edits
feedback.description: Editing on phone and laptop at once silently drops changes.

feedback.title: Slash commands
feedback.description: Type / to insert headings, lists, code blocks and tables.

feedback.title: Pin notes to the top
feedback.description: Keep the three notes I use daily at the top of the list.

feedback.title: Export a notebook as a ZIP of Markdown files
feedback.description: I want a plain-files backup that works with any editor.

feedback.title: Team workspaces with shared tags
feedback.description: Our team needs shared notebooks and a common tag list.

feedback.title: Web clipper for Firefox
feedback.description: The Chrome clipper is great. Please ship a Firefox version.

feedback.title: Version history
feedback.description: Let me restore an older version of a note after a bad edit.

feedback.title: Offline reading on Android
feedback.description: Android users cannot open notes without a connection.

feedback.title: Comment threads on shared notes
feedback.description: Allow readers to leave comments on a shared note.

feedback.title: Live vessel position widget
feedback.description: Add a map widget that shows live vessel positions on dashboards.

feedback.title: Connect to PostgreSQL
feedback.description: We store port call data in Postgres and want to query it directly.

feedback.title: Scheduled dashboard snapshots
feedback.description: Send a PDF snapshot of a dashboard every morning.

feedback.title: Row level permissions
feedback.description: Limit what each customer can see in shared dashboards.

feedback.title: Custom colour themes
feedback.description: Match charts to our corporate palette.

comments.body: We would use this every Monday for our pipeline review.
Thanks! We are looking at delivery formats now.
This would save our ops team hours every week.
PWA would be enough for us as long as push works.
Would love a per-pipeline channel setting.
Offline mode is our top priority this quarter.
Happened to me twice this week.
We are scoping read-only links alongside permissions.
Would help our dispatchers a lot.

roadmapItems.title: Custom contact fields
roadmapItems.description: Add your own fields to contact records.

roadmapItems.description: Cache notebooks on iOS and Android for offline reading and editing.

roadmapItems.title: Markdown tables
roadmapItems.description: Table syntax and a visual table editor.

roadmapItems.title: Sync conflict resolver
roadmapItems.description: Merge edits made on two devices instead of overwriting.

roadmapItems.title: Slash commands
roadmapItems.description: Quickly insert blocks by typing a slash.

roadmapItems.title: Version history
roadmapItems.description: Browse and restore earlier versions of any note.

releaseNotes.summary: Draft notes for the upcoming dashboard performance work.
Bulk edit for deals is here. Select multiple deals and update owner, stage or close date in one step.
Improved CSV import with column mapping and better error messages.
Draft notes for tables and the sync conflict resolver.
Slash commands make writing faster. Type / anywhere to insert headings, lists and code blocks.
